svg.text: most managed option that meets the requirement
Per-source ingestion map: the architect's build sheet
one row per source · what arrives · the factor that decides · the mechanism · what it lands as in Unity Catalog · and the alternative that was rejected (§3.1–3.12, §5.3)
use the most managed option that meets the requirement — drop a rung only when it does not
D-01 · the policy, not a preference
D-03 · SAP, with a fallback already costed
D-12 · the warehouse is not migrated
idempotent on basket key + file id
one stream per topic family, rescued data on
Auto Loader on the SFTP landing
plus a separate low-latency alerting stream
Auto Loader on vendor-delivered files otherwise
preference store as a first-class source
COPY INTO for the small file feeds
one-off bulk export for retained history
COPY INTO from a governed volume
spreadsheet replaced by an entry app in Phase 2
COPY INTO from a governed volume
Every mechanism named here is already in the case — no product is invented for the drawing.
Five mechanisms, thirteen feeds, zero bespoke pollers. Each drop down the ladder is written down and defended in the design review (D-01).
